name: branding-black-and-electric-green-palette-with-manjari-and-inter-specimens
title: Tall colour cards in black, electric green, white, charcoal, grey over giant Manjari and Inter specimens
whatItIs: A black board with a top row of tall rounded colour cards (Pilo Black, Electric Green, Pure White, Charcoal, Mid Gray with hex codes), an outlined 'Fonts & Colors' pill, and two giant white type specimens, rounded Manjari and tight Inter, each with a small alphabet.
whatItMeans: Bold and modern; big cards and giant type make the system feel confident.
techniques: Show colours as tall rounded cards of varied size.
bestFor: Dark presentations of type and colour
